subject.title: fix(config): skip .openclaw append when OPENCLAW_HOME already names a state dir (#45765)

question: Should an explicit `OPENCLAW_HOME` ending in `.openclaw` or `.clawdbot` be treated as the state directory itself, despite the current documented parent-home contract?
rationale: The branch is technically coherent, but automation cannot decide whether basename-dependent overloading is a supported compatibility exception or whether users must use the existing explicit state/config override variables.

options.title: Accept the basename exception
options.body: Treat explicit `.openclaw` and `.clawdbot` homes as state roots, require the documentation update, and land the guard with conflict-safe doctor recovery after rebase.

options.title: Keep parent-home semantics
options.body: Reject the heuristic, preserve the current contract, and improve doctor or onboarding guidance to direct users to `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` and `OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH`.

recommendation.title: Accept the basename exception
recommendation.body: Treat explicit `.openclaw` and `.clawdbot` homes as state roots, require the documentation update, and land the guard with conflict-safe doctor recovery after rebase.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes a core environment-variable and upgrade contract and therefore belongs with the repository's product/config decision owner.
